forkChangesPreserved: Preserved collapsing all comments from a review thread into a single conversation item so resolved discussions do not appear as unfinished duplicate remarks.
Preserved visibility of orphaned review threads when the flat comment feed does not contain their comments, including independently failing host reads.
Preserved newest/oldest conversation ordering and thread activity ordering.
Preserved unresolved and resolved review-thread counters and the conversation summary text, including the “all resolved” state.
upstreamChangesIntegrated: Added normalized cross-host review verdict recognition for approved, changes-requested, and dismissed states.
Added timestamp parsing and newest-commit detection that correctly compares ISO-8601 instants with differing offsets and ignores unparseable commit dates.
Added stale-verdict detection against the newest parseable pull-request commit.
Added per-reviewer latest outcome aggregation, including distinct identities for authorless reviews, out-of-order review handling, dismissal removal, and stale status.
